🔁 #Filament is an #opensource engine for pluggable data replication written in #golang. It moves data from sources to sinks via full, incremental or change data capture (#CDC) replication

🐘 Dear #PHP folks, please don't let the name confuse you :) This is not the #Laravel admin panel, it's a data pipeline engine
